newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki makes new all-time high close, eyes U.S.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki makes new all-time high close, eyes U.S.

text.p: Shares muscled higher in sturdy volume on Friday, with the HEX index rising 0.66 percent to a record high 3,064.54 points, but brokers said the mood turned hesitant ahead of the Fed's meeting on interest rates next week.

"Sentiment is insecure because of mixed feelings over whether the Fed will hike rates next week," one said, referring to the U.S. Federal Reserve's open market committee meeting on Tuesday, following a public holiday in much of Europe on Monday.
Nokia added 2.00 markka to a new year-high 339.00 close, after scratching resistance at 340.00 markka, but trade was thin and it failed to clear higher after touching 341.00.
